blindSourceSummaries: NOTE: page not retrievable at fetch time (404 - the equality project has retired/moved this map entry); the underlying equality-map page carried the authoritative per-state list of bans on transgender people using public bathrooms and facilities matching their gender identity, with the year each was enacted (the dossier's facility-ban years come from it). For this state/province it documents the 2025 facility ban.

An independent traveller-risk assessment map for transgender visitors (July 2026; republished 27 Aug 2026 by a regional LGBTQ outlet), built from 5 years of daily legislative tracking with a severity rubric, lists this state/province among the jurisdictions whose laws most target transgender adults. It also notes that federal policies keep creating legal difficulties for transgender people nationwide.
